summary: Alpha Technology Group, a BVI-incorporated Hong Kong IT services issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026, plus a note that Alpha HK acquired 100% of Zhengzhou Ouqin Information Technology on November 4, 2025. No terms, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed, and the acquisition closed pre-period and is disclosed only as context. Revenue rose to HK$4.53m while net loss widened to HK$10.05m; no transaction mechanics are live.
